title: Kettle & Kite: your usual, ready when you are
logline: For the regulars of a neighbourhood tea house: the new app gets your usual ready before you walk in, so the morning ritual stays a ritual.

cast.description: The tea house owner, a woman in her 50s with short silver-streaked curls, round glasses, a mustard apron over a striped shirt, warm and quick to smile.
A regular, a young nurse in her late 20s with dark hair in a low bun, navy scrubs under an open raincoat, tired but kind eyes.

music.prompt: Warm acoustic brand-film score, about 65 seconds, 84 BPM, instrumental only. 0:00-0:12 soft fingerpicked acoustic guitar and light rain ambience, a little weary; 0:12 a gentle lift with soft piano; 0:14-0:45 light, playful momentum with brushed percussion and pizzicato strings; 0:45-1:05 a bright, hopeful swell resolving on a warm sustained chord. Cosy, human, never cheesy, no vocals.

shot.setting: A rainy street at early morning outside a small tea house with big glowing windows
shot.action: She walks quickly along the wet pavement after a night shift, hood up, glances at the warm window of the tea house and checks the time on her watch.
shot.camera: Slow tracking shot from across the street

voice.text: Some mornings, there's no time to wait.

shot.setting: Inside the tea house during the morning rush, wooden shelves of tea tins, steam rising
shot.action: She pours hot water into a row of teapots, glances up at a queue out of focus and gives a small, apologetic smile.

voice.text: And some rituals are worth keeping.

card.headline: The Kettle & Kite app
card.sub: Your usual, ready when you are.

voice.text: Introducing the Kettle and Kite app.
Pick your usual, pay ahead, and collect it from the shelf.
It's ready in about five minutes, seven days a week.

shot.setting: The pick-up shelf inside the tea house, a paper cup and a small teapot waiting
shot.action: She steps in from the rain, lowers her hood, picks up her waiting cup from the wooden shelf and breathes in the steam with a relieved smile.

voice.text: Seasonal blends first, a stamp on every cup, and your favourites, remembered.

shot.setting: The tea house counter in soft morning light
shot.action: The owner waves warmly across the counter; the nurse raises her cup in thanks and they share a laugh.

card.headline: Your usual, ready when you are.
card.cta: Download the app. Your first pot is on us.

voice.text: Kettle and Kite. Download the app, and your first pot is on us.
